blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Pasay cop faces a complaint from the National Police Commission (Napolcom) after his live-in partner accused him of repeatedly beating and threatening her throughout their nearly six years of living together. The live-in partner, identified only as alias Kara, filed an administrative complaint against Police Staff Sgt. Tyran John Miranda at the Napolcom central office on Thursday. “Repeated abuse, physically, emotionally, and mentally. He repeatedly beat me,” Kara said at a press briefing. Showing security camera footage that went viral after she posted it online, Kara said Miranda kicked her on a staircase and went after her […]...
